scope: Radiation Oncology/Radiotherapy and Pathology, MD and DNB; no generalisation to other parent specialties.
name_note: INI-SS is the superspecialty entrance examination. INI-CET is a different examination; there is no combined INI-CET-SS route in this comparison.
cycle_note: The compared documents belong to different admission cycles: NEET-SS 2025 (counselling in 2026) and INI-SS January 2027. This is a rule comparison, not a same-year seat comparison. Future rules may change before a current MD/DNB entrant finishes training.

status_legend.Yes: Parent qualification explicitly listed, subject to all other rules and the actual course/seat offer.
status_legend.No: This parent specialty is not among the listed feeders for this institute/course; it is not a claim that the parent branch has no SS options.
status_legend.Confirm equivalent degree: MD in the parent specialty is listed with equivalent-degree wording; this table does not automatically settle DNB equivalence. Obtain current institute confirmation.
status_legend.Confirm DNB acceptance: The quoted feeder names MD only; DNB is not explicitly named for this course in the checked rule.
status_legend.Not listed in NEET-SS 2025: This named destination was not found in the checked NEET-SS 2025 feeder tables; it may be an INI-specific route, not an unrecognised course.

highlights: Radiation Oncology/Radiotherapy to Medical Oncology: permitted by NEET-SS 2025. In INI-SS January 2027, JIPMER explicitly lists MD/DNB Radiotherapy; PGIMER lists MD Radiotherapy or equivalent. AIIMS lists Medicine/Paediatrics, excluding this parent specialty under its listed rule.

Pathology to Clinical Haematology: permitted by NEET-SS 2025, but the checked INI-SS AIIMS/PGIMER lists name Medicine/Paediatrics or Medicine; Pathology is not listed. Clinical Haematology and Haematopathology are different courses.

Medical Genetics: NEET-SS 2025 permits any MD/MS/DNB broad specialty. The checked INI-SS lists are narrower: AIIMS Paediatrics/Medicine/Obstetrics & Gynaecology, PGIMER Paediatrics. Neither Pathology nor Radiation Oncology is listed.

Pathology retains INI-specific options: Haematopathology, PGIMER Histopathology and NIMHANS Neuropathology, alongside AIIMS Oncopathology. AIIMS also lists MD Pathology for Tropical Infectious Diseases & Infection Control; DNB acceptance is not explicit there.
A course name containing Pathology does not make MD/DNB Pathology a feeder: INI-SS Forensic Pathology lists Forensic Medicine/Forensic Medicine & Toxicology.

system_comparison.neet: NEET-SS 2025 feeder permissions for DM/DrNB; exact course award and counselling matter.
system_comparison.ini: INI-SS January 2027 DM/MCh eligibility, varying by institute/course. INI-CET is separate.

system_comparison.aspect: Qualification is not inferred from the exam name
system_comparison.neet: Annexures A/B specify feeders. The Medical Genetics any-MD/MS/DNB rule does not open every Medical Group course.
system_comparison.ini: Use the institute-specific feeder row, Part B and notices. A feeder at JIPMER may be excluded at AIIMS.

system_comparison.neet: The positive routes in this focused comparison explicitly accept MD/DNB; preserve the exact listed parent specialty.
system_comparison.ini: Some rows explicitly name MD/DNB; others name MD or equivalent, or MD only. Keep unresolved equivalence conditional.

system_comparison.neet: Relevant question-paper group matters: Medical Oncology Group, Medical Group for Genetics/Clinical Haematology, Pathology Group for Onco-Pathology.
system_comparison.ini: Course-specific application/eligibility. January 2027 Part A describes Stage I for all and Stage II departmental assessment for AIIMS/PGIMER only; apply the full merit rules.

system_comparison.neet: Do not import INI age limits into NEET-SS; check the intended bulletin, qualification-completion date and counselling rules.
system_comparison.ini: January 2027 Part A: base upper ages AIIMS 35, PGIMER 45, NIMHANS 37, SCTIMST 40 as of 1 January 2027; JIPMER no upper age limit. Relaxation/sponsorship exceptions and the NIMHANS all-category rule need individual checking. Qualification/tenure deadline stated as 31 January 2027.

system_comparison.neet: A permitted feeder does not guarantee a course/college seat, category eligibility, rank or admission.
system_comparison.ini: Part A and Part B seats may change. General, sponsored and foreign-national provisions are distinct; a qualifying course with zero applicable seats is not an available choice.

system_comparison.neet: Passing or obtaining a further qualification does not establish a pay premium or suitable employment.
system_comparison.ini: An institute-specific SS route is an option, not a requirement for every parent-specialty job or a guaranteed career upgrade.
